描述_EN: c.76-2008 acquired through the generosity of gerard and sarah griffin gillian lowndes (1936–2010) ‘scroll’ 1996 gillian lowndes’ sculptural works suggest associations with familiar objects, yet remain enigmatic and strange. her series of ‘scrolls’ recall furled paper, yet their bone china and fibre glass forms are rendered rigid and unyielding. made in toppesfield, essex bone china and fibre glass, hand-built, with stainless steel rope museum no. clay is often worked in unconventional ways, and in combination with other materials and found objects.
描述_ZN: C.76-2008 通过Gerard和Sarah Griffin的慷慨解囊获得。 Gillian Lowndes (1936-2010) 'scroll' 1996 Gillian Lowndes的雕塑作品让人联想到熟悉的物体，但又保持神秘和奇怪。 她的一系列 "卷轴 "让人想起了卷曲的纸张，然而他们的骨瓷和纤维玻璃的形式被渲染成僵硬和不屈的。 在埃塞克斯郡托普斯菲尔德制作的骨瓷和玻璃纤维，手工制作，带有不锈钢绳博物馆编号。 粘土经常以非常规的方式工作，并与其他材料和现成的物体相结合。
